plugins.name: second-look
plugins.description: A second look at your code: a read-only reviewer that scales its depth to the risk of the change, checks the other side of cross-repo changes, and verifies every finding; plus skills to review a PR end to end and to write a project's REVIEW.md.

plugins.name: tidy
plugins.description: Behaviour-preserving cleanup of your changes, a PR, a branch or a path, run only when you ask: applies small simplifications that tests guard, proposes the rest; cleanups of committed code get their own commit, cleanups in uncommitted files stay uncommitted.
